title.en: The Four Treasures of the Study

content.zh: 古代的小朋友学写字，桌上必须摆着四样宝贝：毛笔、墨汁、宣纸和砚台。这就叫“文房四宝”哦！
content.en: Ancient kids needed four treasures on their desks to write: the brush, ink, paper, and inkstone. They are called the 'Four Treasures of the Study'!

content.zh: 我们每个人都有属于自己的小动物！它们是鼠、牛、虎、兔、龙、蛇、马、羊、猴、鸡、狗、猪。你属什么呢？
content.en: Everyone has a special animal! They are Rat, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon, Snake, Horse, Goat, Monkey, Rooster, Dog, and Pig. Which one are you?

content.zh: 古代中国人超级聪明，发明了四样了不起的东西：造纸术、指南针、火药和印刷术！过年放的鞭炮，就是火药哦！
content.en: Ancient Chinese people were super smart and invented four amazing things: papermaking, the compass, gunpowder, and printing! The firecrackers for New Year are made of gunpowder!

title.zh: 冬天不怕冷的“岁寒三友”

content.zh: 冬天大雪纷飞的时候，有三种植物依然绿油油的，它们是松树、竹子和梅花。古人夸它们勇敢，叫它们“岁寒三友”。
content.en: When it snows in winter, three plants stay green: pine, bamboo, and plum blossoms. Ancient people called them the 'Three Friends of Winter' because they are brave!

content.zh: 我们唱歌有 Do Re Mi Fa Sol，古代中国人也有自己的五个音符哦，它们叫：宫、商、角、徵、羽！
content.en: We sing Do Re Mi Fa Sol, but ancient Chinese people had their own five notes: Gong, Shang, Jue, Zhi, and Yu!
